name: A place to sit
text: The old log would like company. Something to sit on while the forest grows.

name: A light for dark nights
text: Foxfire glows for a night or two. Set in a lantern, it lasts much longer.

name: Stepping stones
text: A path for small feet between the stony ground and the dug earth.

name: A box of flowers
text: Bloom and Verdure in one tidy box.

name: A birdbath
text: Pool reeds, foxfire-stained caps and a stone bowl.

name: A crystal lamp
text: Flowers from the rock garden and stars from the deep ground.

name: A fairy ring
text: Five toadstools in a circle. Nobody is quite sure who dances in it.

name: A wind chime
text: Crystal and glow, hung where the meadow breeze can reach them.

name: The root arch
text: An arch of old roots, the way into the deep forest.

name: Mushroom lamp
text: A toadstool that glows at the rim.

name: Twig fence
text: A little fence of twigs.

name: Pebble cairn
text: Stones, stacked with care.

name: Log stool
text: A short round of log to sit on.

name: Raised bed
text: A bed of deep soil: plant in it, and it gives a little more.

name: Gravel path
text: Fine gravel for paths between the beds.
